Definition: Maher-Shalal-Chash-Baz; the symbolical name of the son of Isaiah
BiblicalUsage: Mahershalalhashbaz = Maher-shalal-hash-baz "swift is booty, speedy is prey"; 1) symbolic name given by Isaiah by the Lord's direction to Isaiah's son; prophetic indication that Damascus and Samaria were soon to be plundered by the king of Assyria
